meta.title: SAP MM (Purchase Requisition): PR approved in Procol → PO created in SAP
gaps: Verify that the SAP MM integration is configured with the required RFC/API parameters
Approve a purchase requisition in Procol
Trigger creation of a purchase order in SAP from the approved Procol PR
Observe that the integration runs successfully
Compare PR number, line items, GL code, cost centre, plant, vendor, amount, and currency between Procol and SAP
Verify that no integration error was recorded
unconfirmed label "Purchase Items" (expect_visible) — not among the labels known from the app nor in the case
